hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $5$ units left relative to $\blueD f$. 



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A parabola f and graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f has a vertex around (two, negative three). It passes through points (zero, negative four) and (four, negative four). Graph g has a vertex around (negative three, negative three). It passes through points (negative five, negative four) and (one, negative four). A dashed arrow points from graph f's vertex to graph g's vertex.

hints.content:
This means the value of $\redD{g}$ at a number $x$ is the same as the value of $\blueD{f}$ at a number $5$ more than $x$. 

  What would this sentence look like as an equation?

question.content:
